name: Phoenix Flight Academy
summary: Utah flight school at Spanish Fork Airport with rates effective March 1, 2026 and both a minimum and an average private pilot total.
differentiator: Publishes a $9,400 minimum and an $11,500 average total for a private pilot certificate; the average, 22% higher, adds the extra instruction and retakes the school says students usually need.
pricing: Training aircraft $155 an hour with fuel (40-hour minimum), instruction $50 an hour.

aircraft.label: Training aircraft (model not named on the rate line), 40-hour minimum
Piper PA28R-201 Arrow III, complex endorsement

estimate.hoursBasis: FAA minimum hours: 20 hours of instruction at $50 and 40 hours of aircraft at $155
estimate.note: The school's average total is $11,500 and includes additional instruction and test retakes.

bestFor: Students near Spanish Fork Airport who want a minimum and an average total side by side.
skipIf: You want the aircraft model named next to each rate.
watchOut: The aircraft rate carries a 40-hour minimum and instruction a 20-hour minimum.
The $155 aircraft is not named on the rate line.
